description: Lets ImagineBook and Stendhal share the Minecraft book editor: drops the faint page copy that doubles formatted text.

mods.name: Book Editor Compat
mods.description: Lets ImagineBook and Stendhal share the book editor. Stendhal cancels vanilla's init and rebuilds the screen, so the page text comes from vanilla's EditBoxWidget, which starts every wrapped line on a clean style. ImagineBook paints a faint copy of the same page on top so text stays readable over an image, but it lays that copy out with wrapLines, which carries a style past a line break. As soon as a formatting code is typed, the copy goes bold to the end of the page and slides out from under the real text as a grey double. This mod drops that copy inside the book editor and leaves everything else in both mods alone.
